images.prompt: A photograph of a hand-painted sign on a warm cream stucco exterior wall, shot straight on in warm late afternoon daylight, filling the whole frame. Hand-lettered by a family member, not a designer: thick deep red brush letters with a hand-drawn green outline, uneven letter spacing, one letter slightly larger than the rest, paint sun-faded and slightly chalky, small chips where the stucco has flaked, a small crudely painted green cactus with two arms beside the lettering. Visible stucco texture, a hairline crack, a faint water stain low on the wall. Flat unretouched phone-camera look, slightly crooked crop. The stucco wall fills the entire canvas edge to edge, corner to corner: NO card, NO panel, NO plaque, NO tile, NO frame, NO border, NO drop shadow, NO white margin. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: La Taqueria Verdadera #2 . No other letters, words, numbers or symbols may appear anywhere.

Amateur wide smartphone photo taken inside a small family taqueria, no people anywhere in frame. A short order counter with a worn laminate top, a steam table behind sneeze glass with metal pans of stewed meat and rice, a tall stack of thin white paper plates, a squeeze bottle of red salsa and a napkin dispenser, a bowl of limes, a small blank whiteboard and a blank unpainted board on the wall above with no writing on them, a domed drink barrel with a spigot at the end of the counter, a fly strip, a wall calendar turned to a blank page, scuffed terracotta floor tile, a plastic bin of foil sheets. Dim warm interior light with the flash off, slightly underexposed and noisy, mixed white balance, one window blowing out on the left. Slightly crooked horizon, flat unretouched phone-camera look, visible sensor noise. Wide 16:9 crop. No text anywhere, no writing, no readable signage, no logos, no labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

images.reason: first take read as polished advertising photography (crisp focus, dark glossy backdrop, no flash fault); reshot with point-blank on-camera flash, fluorescent cast and a cluttered prep counter
